title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY) Housing Assistance
issuing_authority: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India
summary: Direct financial assistance and subsidy grants for pucca housing construction for low-income and displaced families in India.
description: Provides financial aid up to ₹1,20,000 to ₹2,50,000 for constructing or upgrading primary residences for economically weaker sections (EWS) and flood/disaster displaced households.

document_requirements.purpose: Verify national identity and biometric authentication
document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) portal or enrollment center
Block Development Office (BDO) or Revenue Officer

title: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi Income Support
issuing_authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
summary: Direct annual income support of ₹6,000 in three equal installments to farmer families across India.
description: Provides supplementary financial assistance to small and marginal farmer families to procure agricultural inputs and meet emergency household needs.

title: Bihar Emergency Flood Relief & Shelter Assistance
issuing_authority: Disaster Management Department, Government of Bihar
summary: Immediate cash relief grant (₹6,000 per household) and emergency shelter repair grants for flood-affected families in Bihar.
description: Provides direct financial assistance to households in declared flood-affected districts of Bihar for emergency food, clothing, shelter repair, and immediate displacement relief.

document_requirements.purpose: Verify state residency in Bihar flood-affected district
document_requirements.how_to_obtain: District Magistrate Office or Circle Office (CO)

document_requirements.purpose: Direct benefit transfer of flood relief grant

title: Delhi National Food Security Card (PDS Food Grains)
issuing_authority: Department of Food Supplies & Consumer Affairs, Govt of NCT of Delhi
summary: Highly subsidized monthly food grain allowance (5 kg per person) for low-income households in Delhi.
description: Provides essential food grains (wheat, rice, sugar) through Fair Price Shops (FPS) to Priority Household (PRH) cardholders in the National Capital Territory of Delhi.

document_requirements.purpose: Entitlement verification at Fair Price Shop

title: Aadhaar Enrollment, Card Issue & Identity Update Services (UIDAI)
issuing_authority: Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI), Govt of India
summary: Official portal for new Aadhaar card enrollment, biometric update, demographic address update, and PVC identity card requests.
description: Enables citizens across India to apply for a new 12-digit Aadhaar number, update address or mobile details, download e-Aadhaar PDF, or locate official UIDAI enrollment centers.

document_requirements.purpose: Verify official name and identity (Voter ID, Passport, PAN Card)
document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Respective issuing authority portal or officer

document_requirements.purpose: Verify residential address (Electricity bill, Ration card, Bank statement)

title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Free Hospitalization Insurance
issuing_authority: National Health Authority (NHA), Government of India
summary: Cashless health coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
description: Provides cashless hospitalization and medical treatment coverage across empanelled public and private hospitals for low-income families identified under SECC data.

document_requirements.how_to_obtain: PMJAY portal or hospital Pradhan Mantri Arogya Mitra counter

title: National Career Service (NCS) Jobseeker Registration & Skill Training
issuing_authority: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India
summary: Free nationwide job search, employment exchange registration, career counseling, and skill training programs for unemployed youth.
description: Connects jobseekers in India with verified public and private employers, offering job matching services, skill assessment, and employment assistance.

title: National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) Senior Pension
issuing_authority: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India
summary: Monthly pension grants for BPL senior citizens, widows, and persons with severe disabilities.
description: Provides financial security to vulnerable elderly citizens (aged 60+), widows, and disabled individuals belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) households.

document_requirements.purpose: Verify senior citizen age eligibility (60+ years)
document_requirements.how_to_obtain: UIDAI center or birth certificate registrar

title: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) Small Business Loan
issuing_authority: Micro Units Development & Refinance Agency Ltd. (MUDRA), Govt of India
summary: Collateral-free micro loans up to ₹10,00,000 for non-farm small businesses, micro enterprises, and self-employed entrepreneurs.
description: Facilitates institutional credit to micro enterprises in manufacturing, trading, and services sectors under Shishu, Kishore, and Tarun categories.

title: Birth & Death Registration (Civil Registration System - CRS)
issuing_authority: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, Govt of India & State Municipalities
summary: Official registration and issuance of official Birth Certificates and Date of Birth proof for newborns and delayed registrations.
description: Enables parents and citizens across India to register births within 21 days for free at local municipal corporations, panchayats, or hospital registrars, and download digitally signed birth certificates.

document_requirements.purpose: Proof of birth place, date, and attending medical practitioner
Verify parents' identity and permanent address

title: State e-District Services (Income, Caste, Residence & Domicile Certificates)
issuing_authority: Department of Revenue & General Administration, State Government
summary: Online application and verification for Income, Caste (Jati), Residence (Nivas), and Character certificates.
description: Allows citizens to apply online via State ServicePlus / e-District portal for official revenue certificates issued by Block Development Officer (BDO) or Circle Officer (CO).

document_requirements.purpose: Applicant declaration of income, caste, or residence

title: Sarathi Parivahan Driving License & Vehicle Services
issuing_authority: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH), Govt of India & State RTOs
summary: Online application for Learner's License (LL), Permanent Driving License (DL), DL renewal, and address change.
description: Facilitates online driving license application, slot booking for RTO track test, online LL test, and issuance of chip-based Smart Card DL.

document_requirements.document_name: Proof of Age (Aadhaar / Birth Certificate / 10th Marksheet)
document_requirements.purpose: Verify minimum age eligibility (18+ years for LMV)
Verify RTO jurisdiction and medical fitness

title: Passport Seva Online Application & Renewal (MEA)
issuing_authority: Consular, Passport & Visa (CPV) Division, Ministry of External Affairs, Govt of India
summary: Official online portal for fresh Ordinary Indian Passport, Tatkaal application, and Passport Renewal.
description: Enables Indian citizens to register, pay online fees, schedule appointment slots at Passport Seva Kendra (PSK / POPSK), and track police verification status.

document_requirements.document_name: Proof of Present Address (Aadhaar / Passbook / Utility Bill)
Proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate / PAN / School Certificate)
document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Registrar of Births / Income Tax Department

title: FEMA Disaster Emergency Housing & Shelter Assistance
summary: Immediate financial assistance for temporary rental housing, home repairs, and emergency lodging following declared US natural disasters.
description: Provides funds to individuals and families in the United States whose primary residence was destroyed or rendered uninhabitable by severe weather, floods, or natural disasters.

document_requirements.how_to_obtain: State Licensing Bureau or Passport Agency

document_requirements.document_name: Proof of US Residency or Occupancy
document_requirements.purpose: Verify primary residence in declared US disaster zone
document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Utility bill, lease agreement, or property tax statement

title: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP)
summary: Monthly Electronic Benefit Transfer (EBT) card food purchasing allowance for low-income US residents.
description: Provides monthly food purchasing assistance to low-income households in the United States earning below 130% of federal poverty guidelines.

document_requirements.how_to_obtain: Recent pay stubs or tax statement

title: US Unemployment Insurance (UI) & Jobseeker Stipend
issuing_authority: US Department of Labor / State Employment Agencies
summary: Weekly partial income replacement for US workers who lost employment through no fault of their own.
description: Offers weekly financial support for up to 26 weeks while US recipients actively seek new employment.

title: US Low-Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP)
summary: One-time financial grants to assist low-income US households with heating and utility bills.
description: Helps vulnerable families and seniors in the US pay home energy bills during severe weather events.

title: National Food Security Act (NFSA) & PMGKAY Free Ration & Grocery Support
issuing_authority: Department of Food & Public Distribution, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Govt of India
summary: Monthly free and highly subsidized food grains (wheat, rice, pulses) and essential grocery support for low-income and vulnerable families across India.
description: Provides 5 kg free food grains per month per person under PM-GKAY to Priority Household (PHH) and Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) ration cardholders across all states in India.

document_requirements.purpose: Verify ration entitlement at Fair Price Shop (FPS)
document_requirements.how_to_obtain: State Food & Civil Supplies portal or Block Development Office

document_requirements.purpose: Biometric e-POS authentication at ration shop
